subtitle: UPDATE Aug 4, 18:30, 61 days from the first round. ⚠️ THE POLLING SIDE IS FROM TODAY, THE MARKET SIDE IS FROM YESTERDAY: the capture lock blocked four straight rounds on Aug 4, with Caiado's book swinging between 1.65% and 2.30% across eight minutes, and the panel does not publish a price that two readings fail to confirm. The prices here come from the capture locked at 19:11 UTC on Aug 3. THE FRESH DATA IS APPROVAL: [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) released today, from the same round as yesterday, 47% government approval against 48% disapproval, and approval has been stuck at 47% for three rounds of the house. On the board, ZEMA ANNOUNCED HIS RUNNING MATE, Senator Eduardo Girão of the [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) party, and FLÁVIO TOOK TWO REFUSALS, from Republicanos and Podemos, leaving him without one.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: Price from Aug 3: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 65.50% (vol USD 7.92M accumulated), from the capture locked at 19:11 UTC. On Aug 4 the lock blocked four times and there is no fresh price. Today's data point is APPROVAL: 47% against 48% disapproval in [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg), stuck at 47% for three rounds of the house.
fortes: He still leads all four national polls released since Jul 29, without exception, and wins the four runoff scenarios in today's [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) round: 46% x 45% against Flávio, 46% x 42% against Caiado, 46% x 40% against Zema and 47% x 37% against Renan Santos.
His price did NOT give ground on the day the polling tightened: it stood still at 65.50% for a second straight session, which separates the polling move from the market move.
The 1pp decline in the first round and the 1pp decline in the runoff, inside [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg), both fall WITHIN the 2pp margin. In isolation, they are not movement.
Among the four national polls since Jul 29, three put the first-round gap between 6pp and 9.3pp, and the one that tightens to 4pp is this one. The harshest reading for him is, so far, a single house.
The 2026 annual inflation contract concentrates 36.60% in the 5.00% to 5.49% band and its bands add to 99.65%, inside the coherence gate, with no runaway tail priced in.
fracos: The gap closed 0.90pp and went to +40.05pp. In the daily series, it had not been below that since Jul 30, when it marked +39.50pp.
The price sits 1.00pp BELOW the series peak, which is 66.50%, from the Aug 1 close, and the gap sits 1.75pp below the maximum of +41.80pp, from the same date.

In [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) the runoff became a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico): 46% x 45%, a 1pp difference inside the 2pp margin. In the institute's Jul 27 round it was 4pp.
Today's round did not publish approval or disapproval, so the ratings picture has had no fresh reading since Jul 30.

The Federal Police asked the [STF](/en/glossary#stf) to open a third inquiry into Lulinha, on suspicion of influence peddling (Folha and O Globo, Aug 3). The panel records the fact and attributes no electoral effect.
candidates.analise: His day is one of fresh approval data and an unpublished price, and the two things need to be said separately. THE APPROVAL came out today, from the same [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) round as yesterday (n=2,002, fieldwork Jul 31 to Aug 2, BR-02874/2026): 47% approve of the government and 48% disapprove. The finding is not the level, it is the STILLNESS: inside the house itself, approval stands at 47% across the last three rounds, Jul 13, Jul 27 and now, and what oscillated was disapproval, from 47% to 49% and back to 48%, always inside the 2pp margin. A series that does not move across three readings describes a divided and stable electorate, not a trend. On ADMINISTRATION RATINGS, which is a different question and does not mix with approval, it is 37% excellent or good, 18% average and 43% poor or terrible, against 36% and 43% on Jul 27. Also still. ⚠️ The panel CHANGED SOURCE on this field, which through yesterday carried the Jul 29 reading, and therefore publishes no variation against it: comparing different houses would be changing the yardstick mid-measurement. PoderData/Aya of Jul 30, the other recent reading, gives a considerably harsher picture, 43% x 49%. The two keep pointing different ways. THE PRICE DOES NOT ENTER TODAY: the lock blocked four rounds, and what the panel publishes is the capture locked on Aug 3, with him at 65.50% and a gap of +40.05pp. In his camp, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) had a full day: Dino AUTHORISED the third inquiry into Lulinha and opened an investigation into leaks, and Lula himself told an aide to explain a loan taken from a friend of Lulinha under investigation. The panel records the facts and attributes no electoral effect.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: Price from Aug 3: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 25.45% (vol USD 7.86M accumulated), from the capture locked at 19:11 UTC. On Aug 4 he took TWO alliance refusals, from Republicanos and Podemos, and remains without a running mate eleven days from the deadline he himself declared.
fortes: [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) gives 37% in the first round, against 33% in the institute's own Jul 27 round. The 4pp rise is DOUBLE the 2pp margin, so it is not explained by sampling noise.
In the runoff he goes from 43% to 45% and sits 1pp behind Lula, within the margin: it is a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) for the first time in this series from the house.
The price rose 0.90pp on the same day, to 25.45%, and closed the gap on its own, without the leader giving ground.
He is the comfortable favourite in the second-place contract, at 80.50%, which describes a runoff the market treats as all but settled.
He received an explicit endorsement from Javier Milei, who again attacked Lula publicly on Aug 2 and Aug 3 (Folha and O Globo).
fracos: His market series dismantles any reading of a comeback: the peak is 45.20%, from May 7, and the floor is 22.00%, from Jul 3. Today's 25.45% is recovery INSIDE a lowered range.
The 37% reading is the most favourable to him among the four national polls since Jul 29. The other three give first-round gaps of 6pp to 9.3pp, not 4pp.
He loses the four runoff scenarios in today's round, including the tightest one, by 46% x 45%.
The 37% in the first round remains below the level needed to force a favourable runoff without vote transfer from the rest of the field.
He asked for votes ahead of the legal deadline on Aug 1, in Santa Catarina, on the same day Lula did the same in Bahia.
candidates.analise: His day was one of party isolation, and that is a recorded fact, not a reading. REPUBLICANOS confirmed neutrality in the election and refused to join the ticket, and Folha de S.Paulo describes the move as widening his isolation. Podemos then also refused support and decided to stay neutral, after resisting the nomination of its own president, Renata Abreu, as running mate. He remains WITHOUT A RUNNING MATE and said the decision will come by August 15, which gives eleven days. Michelle Bolsonaro called Ciro Nogueira to press for Tereza Cristina in the slot, and Daniella Marques, the previous bet, will stay on the campaign as an adviser after Republicanos withheld its approval. IN THE POLLING HE IS STILL THE MOVE OF THE WEEK: [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Aug 3 took him from 33% to 37% in the first round, a 4pp rise that is double the margin, and from 43% to 45% in the runoff, 1pp behind Lula. But the house caveat still holds: the other three national polls since Jul 29 give gaps of 6pp to 9.3pp, against 4pp here. THE PRICE DOES NOT ENTER TODAY, because the lock blocked four rounds. What the panel publishes is the Aug 3 capture, with him at 25.45%. The crossing left open for tomorrow is exactly this one: he rose in the polling and lost two parties at the same time, and neither has yet passed through a confirmed price.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: [Polymarket](/en/glossary#polymarket) 7.45% (↓0.50pp, vol USD 8.86M accumulated), undoing yesterday's rise. [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) gave 4% in the polling, and the distance between price and polling stands at 3.45pp. Capture locked at 19:11 UTC.
fortes: He has the largest accumulated volume among names priced above 1%, with USD 8.86M, above Lula's own USD 7.92M, at one eighth of his price.
He is the favourite in the third-place contract, at 60.50%, well ahead of Caiado, who is at 25.00%.
The [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) party is losing ground as the anti-establishment party and the panel records O Globo's reading (Aug 2) that he is positioning himself against Zema in that space.
VEJA points to an age bracket in which he stands apart from the rest of the third way in today's [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) round.
The 7.45% price remains well above the 4% polling, which describes a market paying for a scenario that declared voting intention does not yet show.
fracos: He FELL 0.50pp today, undoing yesterday's 0.35pp rise, which had broken nine straight sessions of decline.

[BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) gave 4%, against 5% in the institute's own Jul 27 round. It is the fourth straight national poll measuring him between 3% and 4%, after the 7.8% of [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) on Jul 29.
He loses the runoff against Lula by 47% x 37%, the worst of the four simulations in today's round.
The distance between price (7.45%) and polling (4%) stands at 3.45pp, and it sits on the price side, not the polling side.
High volume with a falling price describes an old position left open, not current conviction.
candidates.analise: His case remains the widest distance between what the market pays and what the polling measures, and today the distance narrowed from both wrong sides. In price, he FELL 0.50pp to 7.45% (vol USD 8.86M), undoing yesterday's 0.35pp rise, which had broken nine straight sessions of decline. In polling, [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) gave 4%, against 5% in the institute's own Jul 27 round. The distance between the two measurements stands at 3.45pp, against 4.95pp yesterday, and the narrowing comes from the price giving way, not from the polling rising. THE POLLING SEQUENCE IS WHAT WEIGHS MOST: after the 7.8% of [AtlasIntel](/en/glossary#atlasintel) on Jul 29, four straight national polls measured him between 3% and 4%, with PoderData at 4%, Vox Brasil at 3.0% and now Nexus at 4%. One isolated high reading against four consistent low ones is the classic outlier pattern, and the panel records it that way. VOLUME REMAINS THE ANOMALY OF THE PIECE: with USD 8.86M accumulated, he has more money traded than Lula, who has USD 7.92M, at a price that is one eighth of his. High volume with a falling price describes an old position left open, not conviction now. In the third-place contract he remains the favourite at 60.50%, against Caiado's 25.00%, which is consistent with a market that sees him finishing third rather than contesting the runoff.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: Prices from Aug 3: Caiado 1.15% (vol USD 5.30M), Zema 0.25% (vol USD 4.66M) and Haddad 0.15% (vol USD 6.64M). ⚠️ THIS IS PRECISELY WHERE the capture lock has been blocking on Aug 4, with Caiado's book swinging between 1.65% and 2.30% across eight minutes.
candidates.subtitle: Aug 2, 63 days out: the chasing pack split, and that is the difference from the previous day, when it shrank as a whole. Camilo Santana, Jair Bolsonaro and Haddad rose; Caiado, Zema, Michelle and Tereza Cristina fell; Alckmin and Tarcísio stood still. Caiado touched the series floor within the day itself, with 0.90% in the 11:30 UTC collection and 1.15% in the locked capture at 19:42 UTC. No name in the pack goes above 1.15%.

caiado.label: CAIADO ([PSD](/en/glossary#psd)), presidential Poly 1.15% (down 0.20pp, vol USD 5.27M) | third place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 24.50% (up 2.00pp, vol USD 37K) | second place 1.10% | candidacy confirmed on Jul 26, with Kassab as running mate | most recent national poll: Vox Brasil Jul 31, first round 5.5%
caiado.fortes: The best national poll in the set is still his, the 5.5% from Vox Brasil of Jul 31, above the 5% from PoderData of Jul 30 and well above the 3.1% from AtlasIntel of Jul 29. In the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he is UP 2.00pp, to 24.50%, recovering the previous day's fall and holding second place there, behind only Renan Santos. And the divergence between institutes about him remains open across FOUR levels within the same month, 6% at Nexus, 5.5% at Vox, 5% at PoderData and 3.1% at AtlasIntel.
caiado.fracos: The winner contract FELL 0.20pp, to 1.15%, in a fourth straight session of decline. And today he TOUCHED THE SERIES FLOOR within the day itself: the 11:30 UTC collection recorded 0.90%, which MATCHES the lowest value since Apr 14, already registered between Jul 5 and Jul 9, and the locked capture at 19:42 UTC shows 1.15%. The panel publishes the locked capture and records the intraday floor rather than picking between the two. What remains is that he gives ground in the winner book for a fourth session while rising in the third-place one, and polling follows neither move.

haddad.label: HADDAD ([PT](/en/glossary#pt)), presidential Poly 0.30% (up 0.05pp, vol USD 6.63M) | second place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.05% | not tested by Vox Brasil in any scenario, because he is running for governor of São Paulo
haddad.fortes: UP 0.05pp in the winner contract, to 0.30%, and holds 1.05% in the second-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His accumulated volume, USD 6.63M, is larger than that of several names priced above him.
haddad.fracos: Vox Brasil does not test him in any scenario, neither first round nor [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and no national poll has been published since, so he still has no fresh polling. The complication stands and needs saying plainly: he is NOT a presidential candidate, he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the scenario that favours him in polls is a hypothesis and not a candidacy in progress. At a price of 0.30%, a rise of 0.05pp carries almost no informational value, and the high volume measures traded history, not current conviction.

zema.label: ZEMA ([Novo](/en/glossary#novo)), presidential Poly 0.25% (down 0.10pp, vol USD 4.64M) | third place in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 4.60% (flat) | Vox Brasil Jul 31: first round 3.2% | confirmed by Novo on Jul 27, still with NO running mate, deadline Aug 5
zema.fortes: In polling he is steady: the 3.2% from Vox of Jul 31 is practically the same as the 3% from PoderData of Jul 30 and sits above the 2.8% from AtlasIntel of Jul 29. He holds FLAT at 4.60% in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), ahead of the whole chasing pack except Caiado.
zema.fracos: He FALLS 0.10pp in the winner contract, to 0.25%. He still has NO running mate, with the Aug 5 deadline three days away, after the [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) ruled out Barbosa for the slot and Marcelo Aro left his Senate ticket, a move Zema publicly called betrayal. Series caveat, and it is a large one: his maximum is 10.10%, from Apr 26, so 0.25% is less than a fortieth of that level and moves in this range carry almost no informational value. Collection caveat, belonging to the panel and not to the market: the AFOS series for that name has NO point after Jul 30, so today's price enters through the locked capture and without comparison to a series close.

candidates.analise: The third way had its busiest day of the cycle and it is the one jamming the capture, which is no coincidence. ZEMA ANNOUNCED HIS RUNNING MATE: Senator Eduardo Girão of the [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) party, confirmed by Folha, O Globo and G1. He is the first of the three to close a ticket, and he closes it inside his own party, without depending on an alliance. CAIADO, formally nominated yesterday, appears today as the name whose price moves most, and the panel does NOT publish that figure because four straight readings failed to confirm it: between 1.65% and 2.30%, a 0.65pp swing across eight minutes. Worth recording what that means as method: a book moving like that is being repriced right now, and publishing a snapshot of it would be publishing an instant, not a price. HADDAD remains at 0.15% and remains a non-candidate, so that contract prices a replacement scenario. IN THE POLLING, [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) of Aug 3 gives Caiado 5% and Zema 3%, and Lula beats both in the runoff, 46% x 42% and 46% x 40%. THE CROSSING THAT MATTERS: the third-way space gained party definition today, with Zema closing a ticket and with Republicanos and Podemos stepping off Flávio's platform, and none of it has yet passed through a price the panel can publish. That is what tomorrow's round will measure.
fortes: CAIADO was formally nominated at his party convention and [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) gave him 5% in the first round, behind only the 5.5% of Vox Brasil on Jul 31 among national polls since Jul 29.
In today's runoff, Caiado loses to Lula by 46% x 42%, the second narrowest margin among the four scenarios tested.
Caiado is the second name in the third-place contract, at 25.00%, behind only Renan Santos.
ZEMA was formally nominated and announced a move from Belo Horizonte to São Paulo for the campaign (O Globo, Aug 3).
Caiado's price, at 1.15%, sits above the 0.90% floor the series touched intraday on Aug 2.
fracos: CAIADO promised to pardon Bolsonaro and those convicted over Jan 8 and called the institutional response to the coup attempt the greatest disaster in history (Valor, Aug 3), which puts him competing for the same electorate as Flávio, who gained 4pp in the polling today.
ZEMA remains at 0.25% in the market and 3% in [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) polling, with no movement on the day of his own convention.
HADDAD pulled back to 0.15% (vol USD 6.64M). He is not a candidate, and the contract prices a replacement scenario.
In the runoff, Zema loses to Lula by 46% x 40%, the second widest margin among the round's four scenarios.
The three combined do not reach 1.60% in the market, against Flávio's 25.45%, which describes a third space the price does not treat as competitive.

cruzamento: THIS ROUND PUBLISHES HALF THE CROSSING, AND SAYS WHICH HALF. The POLLING side is from today. The MARKET side is from yesterday, from the capture locked at 19:11 UTC on Aug 3, because on Aug 4 the capture lock blocked FOUR straight rounds. The reason shifted through the day: it started on thin books and ended on CAIADO, who swung between 1.65% and 2.30% across readings eight minutes apart, a 0.65pp move. The panel does not publish a price that two independent readings fail to confirm, and publishing a snapshot of a moving book is exactly what that rule exists to prevent. --- THE FRESH DATA OF THE DAY IS APPROVAL, and it came from yesterday's round. The correction is declared in the entry itself, rather than rewritten in silence. --- THE FINDING IS NOT THE LEVEL, IT IS THE STILLNESS. Inside [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) itself, approval stands at 47% across the LAST THREE rounds: 47% x 47% on Jul 13, 47% x 49% on Jul 27 and 47% x 48% now. What oscillated was disapproval, and it oscillated 2pp up and 1pp down, inside the margin both times. Three readings without movement describe a divided and stable electorate, not a trend. Administration ratings tell the same story: 37% excellent or good against 43% poor or terrible, versus 36% and 43% on Jul 27. ⚠️ And the panel CHANGED SOURCE on this field, which through yesterday carried the Jul 29 reading, so it publishes no variation against it: comparing different houses is changing the yardstick mid-measurement. PoderData/Aya of Jul 30 still gives a considerably harsher picture, 43% x 49%, and the two houses keep pointing different ways. --- THE PARTY BOARD MOVED MORE THAN THE POLLING DID. ZEMA announced his running mate, Senator Eduardo Girão of the [Novo](/en/glossary#novo) party, and is the first of the three third-way names to close a ticket, and inside his own party at that. FLÁVIO took TWO refusals on the same day, from Republicanos and Podemos, both confirming neutrality, and remains WITHOUT A RUNNING MATE eleven days from the deadline he himself declared, August 15. That is the combination tomorrow will measure: he gained 4pp in the [BTG/Nexus](/en/glossary#nexus-btg) polling and lost two parties in the same week, and neither has yet passed through a price this panel can publish. --- ON THE JUDICIAL AXIS, yesterday's request became today's decision: DINO AUTHORISED the third inquiry into Lulinha and opened an investigation into leaks. The panel recorded yesterday that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) had REQUESTED it, and keeps the distinction between requesting and opening, because that is what separates the news from the fact. Lula told an aide to explain a loan taken from a friend of Lulinha under investigation. With no confirmed price today, there is no way to measure whether the market priced any of it, and the panel says so rather than estimating.
